items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping it.
Hyaluronic acid adds water-binding hydration, which can make dull-looking skin look fresher.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and softens the look of dryness.
A mineral SPF 50 helps keep tone looking even and protects skin during the day.

response.routine_note: I removed the 30% peel because a high-strength acid peel containing salicylic acid is not appropriate during pregnancy, so this gentler routine is a better fit for dullness: cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning. If you want to try exfoliating products later, please check with your prenatal provider first.
